findings.summary: Adjacency classifies a returned refusal as terminal when the next turn ends the run for another reason (budget, timeout, route, context unavailable).
First-step dispatch STALE returned within budget and plain-text KERNEL-VERIFICATION turns increment cont.repairs but are excluded, contradicting the 'as cont.repairs counts' claim.
The repair rate can exceed 1.0; redefine the denominator so every counted refusal maps to one attempt, or state the bound.
Plan 3f.2 Interfaces still names context.compared; the on arm correctly reads context.assembled.
'context turns' counts every context.assembled including acknowledgement packs; word it as packs.
